name: Economy structures: Fleet Academy, Unity Monument, Protectorate Headquarters (MOD-6)

patch.name: Fleet Academy
patch.description: Crews run simulated campaigns until nothing surprises them. Fleets in this system train a little every turn, and new ships launch with graduates aboard.

patch.name: Unity Monument
patch.description: A memorial every citizen of the empire can point to. Raises morale in every colony of the empire.

patch.name: Protectorate Headquarters
patch.description: A governor's seat in a subjugated world. While it stands, subjugated worlds hold order and pay tribute instead of seething. Build it in a subjugated world.
